title: Mysteryless Island

log: Awake. Salt in the mouth. The sea is quiet now. The ship is gone. Behind the dunes, a dark line of trees.
Cold sand under your cheek. Salt on your lips. The sea is flat, grey and empty: no ship. Beyond the dunes, a dark line of trees.
You come to at the tide line, clothes heavy with water. Nothing on the horizon, nothing left of the ship. Behind the dunes, trees.

_ending: the end screen (death is permanent): {time} and {day} in survived, {cause} in cause; recap like activity thoughts

lines.text: You swam ashore with the knife in your fist.
You swam ashore with a tin of matches inside your shirt.
You swam ashore clinging to the water can.
You swam ashore with three days of rations tied to your wrist.
You found the forest beyond the dunes.
You found a spring of clear water.
You made fire in the ring of rocks.
You found shells under the cliff.

recap.otherwise: You never left the sand where the sea put you.

lines.text: You lived through the first night.
You did not see a second morning.

expireLog: The fire goes out. Only embers now.
The last flame dies. The embers glow, then fade.
The fire is out. A thin thread of smoke.
